environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate with PostgreSQL RDS. Database connection uses role 'app_service_rw' with full CRUD permissions (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables in the 'secrets' schema. Service exposed via internal ALB with no additional access controls beyond JWT validation at the API gateway layer. The ENCRYPTION_KEY environment variable is set via ECS task definition secrets from AWS Secrets Manager.

config.database_permissions: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON secrets.*
config.encryption_key_source: AWS Secrets Manager via ECS task definition
